summary.headline_finding: Mode B insider_vs_calendar caught the dominant signal: PROXIMATE_DISCRETIONARY with 9/10 proximate sales non-10b5-1, $6.4M by CFO/VP Fields clustered 13 days after FY27 J-Book release at near-doubled share prices, plus FY25 year-end discretionary sales. Mode B also surfaced that Hypersonics Prototyping PE is UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS in latest J-Book even as ATI sells Mach-7 C-103 refractory hardware — narrow program-level concern. Counterbalanced by strong PASS evidence: 95 granted ATI Properties patents, comprehensive EPA FRS + OSHA facility confirmation, F-35 FUNDED_STEADY at $1.18B FY26, clean ICFR with no restatement history.
